title: The explicit coefficient-pullback and tensor-pull presentations
statement: Use [def-weil-pbc-residue-exchange-comparison-interface], [new-integral-residue-tensor-presentation], [new-integral-residue-ordinary-monoidal]. For a prime ℓ, a normed extension E of ℚ_ℓ, and any scheme morphism f:X→Y, construct f*B_Y ≅ B_X from the exact pullback/single comparison, restriction/pullback, and the regular residue unit. Define the tensor presentation on X by the canonical residue tensor presentation followed by transport along the inverse coefficient isomorphism. These are exactly the constructions previously in new-integral-residue-tensor-geometry, with unchanged data and types.

source.place: Lemma 6.5.9(3), Proposition 6.8.11(3), Remark 6.8.15; explicit formal coefficient and adjunction argument

proof.text: The ordinary restricted-regular pullback comparison is exactly the comparison in the derived single-object constructor. Unfolding proves its defining equation. Apply the model coefficient-counit equation to this exact ordinary pullback and ordinary coefficient isomorphism to obtain the named coefficient-pullback counit equation. The tensor pull presentation is the X tensor presentation followed by the inverse coefficient isomorphism.
